about_heading: Join me on this creative journey
about_text:
It started with a sketchbook and a box of paints. Then I got curious about what else I could make, so I tried clay. Then a pair of plain white sneakers. Then phone covers, tealight holders, a bit of digital art, and a few things I'm still figuring out.

I called this place Bless the Mess because that's what my desk looks like most days: paint on my fingers, clay drying on the table, half-finished ideas everywhere. Some of my favourite pieces came out of that mess, usually from an experiment I wasn't sure would work.

If something here makes you smile, or you have an idea you'd like made by hand, message me on Instagram. I'd love to make it with you.
